en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold Delayed

entries.headline: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold delayed to February 23, 2027, with early access on February 19
entries.summary: Square Enix announced at the Tokyo Fan Festival that Final Fantasy XIV's 8.0 expansion Evercold has moved from its January 2027 window to February 23, with early access beginning February 19. Preorders open November 4.
entries.verification: IGN and Gematsu independently reported the same dates from the Fan Festival announcement; no unverified hour-level timing is stated.
entries.timeNote: Full launch: February 23, 2027; early access: February 19; preorders open November 4, 2026.

entries.headline: Anthropic adds a Claude rule against recreating specific existing games
entries.summary: IGN reports that Anthropic recently pushed a Claude rule allowing original or genre-based games while prohibiting recreations of specific existing games, even when renamed or described as original. The change comes amid complaints about low-effort clones on Steam.
entries.verification: The pinned packet preserves IGN's article and the rule it quotes. With no direct Anthropic changelog in the packet, this is presented as a media report, not an official release note.
entries.timeNote: The rule was reportedly pushed around October 27, 2026; the exact activation time is not confirmed by a first-party page.

entries.headline: Pikmin 4 Switch 2 demo arrives November 2 with save transfer
entries.summary: Nintendo announced during the Pikmin Day Direct that a demo for Pikmin 4 - Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy will launch November 2 and carry save data into the full game. The Switch 2 edition is scheduled for November 12.
entries.verification: 4Gamer explicitly attributes the demo date and save-transfer feature to Nintendo's Pikmin Day Direct; the pinned calendar baseline separately verifies the full version through Nintendo US.
entries.timeNote: Demo: November 2, 2026. Full Switch 2 edition in the calendar: November 12.

entries.headline: Dune: Awakening's free Blood and Ice expansion launches December 1
entries.summary: Funcom has announced Blood and Ice, a free Dune: Awakening expansion with a new snow-covered map and roughly 35 hours of progression. It is scheduled for December 1, while the studio says expansion work will continue through 2027.
entries.verification: PC Gamer's pinned article preserves Funcom's statements on the free expansion, roughly 35 hours of content, and the December 1 date. Platforms not explicit in the snapshot are not extrapolated.

entries.headline: Colorful Palette establishes animation studio LATENT ONE
entries.summary: Colorful Palette, developer of HATSUNE MIKU: COLORFUL STAGE!, has established LATENT ONE as a subsidiary for animation planning, production and producing. Its first showcased work is the game's sixth-anniversary song video, and the studio also plans original projects.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's pinned article cites the companies' public announcements. Only the announced organization, scope and released video are included.
entries.timeNote: The establishment was announced on October 31, 2026.

entries.headline: Report: EA prioritized a new Star Wars Battlefront project over BioWare's Mass Effect
entries.summary: AUTOMATON relays a Bloomberg report citing anonymous sources who say EA compared BioWare's in-development Mass Effect project with a not-yet-started Star Wars Battlefront project, chose the latter and closed BioWare. EA has not publicly confirmed that tradeoff.
entries.verification: The pinned packet contains only AUTOMATON's relay of Bloomberg's anonymous-source report. It is explicitly labeled unconfirmed and not presented as an EA announcement.
entries.timeNote: BioWare's closure was announced October 22, 2026; the internal decision has no verified precise date.

entries.headline: Stranger Than Heaven drops last-gen support to focus on PS5, Xbox Series and PC
entries.summary: RGG Studio producer Hiroyuki Sakamoto told IGN that Stranger Than Heaven was conceived as a new project targeting the team's best current quality, so it is skipping systems such as PS4 and focusing on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC.
entries.verification: The pinned IGN article is a direct interview with producer Hiroyuki Sakamoto and explicitly names the current-generation platforms. No release date is inferred.
entries.timeNote: Interview published October 31, 2026; no launch date is confirmed in this evidence.

entries.headline: Modern Warfare 4 input lag on Switch 2 tests well above PS5
entries.summary: IGN relays Digital Foundry testing that measured about 81 ms of input lag in Switch 2 docked mode and 100 ms in handheld mode, compared with roughly 49.1 ms on PS5. The handheld result is about double the PS5 figure and may create a competitive disadvantage.
entries.verification: The pinned packet preserves IGN's complete relay of Digital Foundry's measurements. The figures are presented as media test results, not publisher specifications.
entries.timeNote: Analysis published October 31, 2026; hour-level timing is not applicable.

entries.headline: Usagi Shima launches as a premium game on Steam
entries.summary: Wholesome Games Presents released studio rabbiko's idle rabbit-collecting game Usagi Shima on Steam on October 29. The game previously launched free on iOS and Android; the PC edition includes more than 100 decorations and a 15% launch discount through November 13.
entries.verification: AUTOMATON's pinned article preserves the publisher, developer, Steam date, mobile background and promotion, alongside the developer's public launch post.
entries.timeNote: Steam launch: October 29, 2026. The 15% launch discount runs through November 13.
